About

A multidisciplinary scientific perspective

Dr. Pradeep Bist earned his M.Sc., M.Phil., and Ph.D. in Microbiology in India. His doctoral research examined recombinant proteins expressed in Escherichia coli for serotyping foot-and-mouth disease virus.

His research career has encompassed virology, biochemistry, molecular biology, bacteriology, drug discovery, cancer biology, and inflammation. Working across these disciplines has shaped his interest in the connections between molecular mechanisms, cellular responses, host–pathogen interactions, and disease outcomes.

He currently serves as Senior Scientific Advisor at Celma Diagnostic Lab, Devaki Clinic, Hosur, Tamil Nadu. His present interests focus on virus–host interactions and emerging infectious diseases, particularly the roles of host responses in viral infection, tissue injury, and therapeutic intervention.

Research

Research Focus and Scientific Interests

My scientific interests lie at the intersection of virology, host–pathogen interactions, molecular biology, and inflammation. I am particularly interested in how viruses interact with host cells, how these interactions influence immune responses and tissue injury, and how mechanistic knowledge can inform therapeutic approaches.

Virus–Host Interactions

How viral proteins and host-cell processes influence infection, viral replication, immune responses, and disease outcomes.

Host Responses and Immunopathology

The roles of innate immune cells, inflammatory mediators, and tissue-specific responses in antiviral protection and infection-associated injury, with particular interest in mast-cell biology.

Antiviral Therapeutics

How viral replication mechanisms, protein structure, molecular interactions, and pharmacological constraints influence antiviral target identification and validation.

Translational Perspectives

Connecting molecular and experimental observations with questions relevant to infectious diseases, therapeutic effectiveness, and clinical interpretation.

Across these areas, I am interested in distinguishing established experimental findings from emerging hypotheses and identifying questions that require further investigation.

Approach to research

Scientific Perspective

My scientific interests are guided by a simple principle: understanding a biological mechanism is as important as recognizing the limits of what our experiments can tell us. I value careful interpretation of evidence and the connection between fundamental research and questions relevant to human health.

Scientific journey

Research across institutions and disciplines

Over the course of his career, Dr. Bist has worked in different scientific capacities at research institutions in India, the United States, and Singapore.

Moving between fields has offered opportunities to learn different experimental approaches and to consider how discoveries in one area of biology may illuminate questions in another.

His academic experience includes the Indian Veterinary Research Institute, Indian Institute of Science, University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA), A*STAR, National University of Singapore, and Duke-NUS Medical School.
